{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN after conversion (due to formatting issues)
# But only after confirming that the non-numeric values are due to formatting
# and not valid data
print("Rows with invalid revenue:", sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isna()])

# Drop rows with invalid revenue
sales_df_clean = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Now compute the mean age of customers, excluding those with invalid age (-1)
mean_age = sales_df_clean[sales_df_clean['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age"}
